scenario.name: Break Escape SAFETYNET: Mission 6 — Follow the Money VMs
scenario.author: Z. Cliffe Schreuders
scenario.description:
# Break Escape SAFETYNET Mission 6: Follow the Money
Virtual machines for the Break Escape SAFETYNET mission 6 narrative experience. These VMs back the "Follow the Money" mission, where operatives infiltrate the Crypto Anarchists' HashChain Exchange and crack their way onto the backend financial servers to map ENTROPY's funding network.
Based on the "Hackme and Crack Me" CTF: gain a foothold on the exchange's backend, crack weak service passwords, then abuse credential reuse to move laterally into the accounts that hold the financial records.
## Included Systems
**hackme_crack_me_lab** (172.16.0.2) - Debian 12 desktop system — HashChain Exchange backend estate - Foothold: an exposed Apache Druid analytics service (unauthenticated remote code execution, CVE-2021-25646) - Escalation: a world-readable shadow file exposes the account hashes for offline cracking - Four accounts hold progressive financial intelligence flags; two of them reuse the same weak password, modelling the exchange's real credential-reuse weakness
**kali_cracker** (172.16.0.3) - Kali Linux platform — the operative's attack box / in-game console - John the Ripper and hashcat for offline password cracking, Metasploit for the Apache Druid foothold, nmap for enumerating the backend estate
## Flag Order (document order — do not reorder without re-checking the game side)
1. **flag_1** — first backend account cracked (initial financial-server access) 2. **flag_2** — second account opened by credential reuse (lateral movement) 3. **flag_3** — the financial database account (transaction records) 4. **flag_4** — full estate access via privilege escalation (complete network access)
These map 1:1, in order, to the four `submit_flags` tasks in `BreakEscape/scenarios/m06_follow_the_money/scenario.json.erb`, which reference `hackme_crack_me_lab:flag_1..4`. The Break Escape flag key is the `system_name` of the flag-bearing target below — keep them identical.
## Integration with Break Escape
These VMs are provisioned by the Break Escape game engine via SecGen integration. Players interact with the systems through the game's narrative and task system, with guided hints delivered via SAFETYNET field guides handed out by Agent HaX.
## CyBOK Coverage
- Attacks and Exploitation (exploitation frameworks, remote code execution) - Authentication (bruteforce, password cracking) - Authorisation (credential reuse, access-control misconfiguration) - Penetration Testing (software tools, active penetration)
